initialCi.failure: Windows archive restoration and durable audio integration tests exceeded their existing 5000 ms deadline (5576 ms and 5025 ms). New induction tests and Linux source checks passed.
initialCi.fix: Cap CI test workers at two to reduce disk contention; preserve per-test deadlines and assertions, with no retries.
initialCi.verification: Full local source gate with CI enabled and both exact-revision source CI jobs passed.

browserFixtureFollowup.failure: Windows browser fixture received ARCHIVE_BUSY when it inspected exported bytes before the completed download had finished staging cleanup. The other 33 browser tests and the full unit gate passed.
browserFixtureFollowup.fix: Assert isolated export staging cleanup completes before starting inspection. No production archive behavior or HTTP retry added.
browserFixtureFollowup.verification: Eight local diagnostic repetitions passed, followed by complete final Windows/Linux source CI with no test retries.
